verdict.rationale: CT Corporation offers registered-agent and entity-compliance services, where scheduled or background automation (e.g., automated compliance tracking or filings) is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes: one host returned a Cloudflare challenge and the other redirects into that same walled host. Neither says anything about automation, so the verdict is none, with low confidence because no product content could be read.
